svg.aria-label: Computed fundamental output amplitude versus amplitude modulation index: linear up to 1, then overmodulation flattening towards the square-wave limit of 4 over pi
svg.text: Fundamental amplitude vs. m_a: linear to 1, then it bends toward the square-wave limit

text.tspan: V_1/V_dc vs. m_a — the linear region ends at m_a = 1; beyond it the output saturates at 4/π
